{{Quote|Welcome to Nashal, friend! I like to think of our beautiful city as the friendliest on Talus, which is of course the friendliest planet of the Five Brothers. I'm sure you've noticed that everyone here sports a smile. That's because we love visitors. And if you're here to work, we love you even more. As a matter of fact, I have an assignment for you right now. Are you willing to make some credits the good old-fashioned way?|Slooni Jong to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Slooni Jong''', referred to as '''pookie''' by one of his [[Gender/Legends|female]] cabinet members, was the [[Human/Legends|Human]] male [[Chief Administrator/Legends|Chief Administrator]] of [[Nashal]], a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Double Worlds|Twin]] [[Planet/Legends|World]] of [[Talus/Legends|Talus]]. Jong lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Slooni Jong was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
